scoring_justification: Recomputing from finite-element simulation outputs is infeasible in the checker sandbox; agent-reported scalar values are compared against paper-reported gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for MRV ratio and effective moduli, sourced from paper Table 2 and Fig. 2 conclusion.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published results; we assert no fabrication beyond paper.

outputs.description: The smallest normalized side length L_f/d at which the two-point correlation function of local elastic moduli approaches unity, i.e., the locally representative mesoscopic volume size.
Effective Young's modulus for the four pore compositions at the determined MRV size. Four rows, one per model type (1-4).

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the MRV size ratio to the paper-reported value within a tolerance, and the effective moduli to known reference values with a relative tolerance. The solving agent must execute all process steps (model generation and FEM) to obtain the results; the final scores are based solely on these two output artifacts.

steps.description: MRV size ratio L_f/d from mrv_size.json
